    [INPUTS]
        <REF> input_string </REF>: any "Value provided to initialize the instance input_string attribute."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> None </REF>: None "This initializer does not return a value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the provided input_string value to self.input_string. RESULT self.input_string]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Manacher.palindromic_length:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Recursively computes the length contribution of a palindrome expansion around a center by stopping at boundaries or mismatched characters and otherwise counting one matched pair per recursive step." palindromic_length]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance context used to make the recursive method call."
        <REF> center </REF>: integer "The center index around which symmetric character comparison is performed."
        <REF> diff </REF>: integer "The current offset from the center used to compare left and right positions."
        <REF> string </REF>: string "The input string in which palindrome symmetry is checked."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "The number of successful recursive palindrome expansion steps from the given center and offset, returning 0 when expansion cannot continue."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the guard condition with left-to-right short-circuit logic: check whether center - diff equals -1, or center + diff equals len(string), or string[center - diff] does not equal string[center + diff]. RESULT guard_condition]
            [COMMAND If the guard condition is true, immediately return 0. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND If the guard condition is false, recursively call self.palindromic_length with the same center, diff + 1, and the same string. RESULT recursive_length]
            [COMMAND Return 1 plus recursive_length. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The left index reaches the exclusive out-of-bounds boundary where center - diff == -1.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Stop expanding before accessing string at index -1 and return 0. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The right index reaches the exclusive out-of-bounds boundary where center + diff == len(string).]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Stop expanding before accessing string at index len(string) and return 0. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Both boundary checks are false but the symmetric characters differ, so string[center - diff] != string[center + diff].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Stop palindrome expansion because the characters at the mirrored positions do not match and return 0. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Manacher.palindromic_string:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds a pipe-separated version of the input string, finds the longest palindrome centered in that transformed string, and returns the corresponding original-character palindrome without separator markers." palindromic_string]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.input_string </REF>: string "The source string from which the longest palindromic substring is derived."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> output_string </REF>: string "The longest palindromic substring reconstructed from the transformed string by removing pipe separators."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize max_length to 0, new_input_string to an empty string, and output_string to an empty string. RESULT max_length, new_input_string, output_string]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each character i in self.input_string from index 0 up to but not including the last character, and append i followed by the literal separator "|" to new_input_string. RESULT new_input_string]
            [COMMAND After the preceding loop, append the last character self.input_string[-1] to new_input_string without adding a trailing separator. RESULT new_input_string]
            [COMMAND Iterate i from 0 up to but not including len(new_input_string), and within that loop compute length by calling self.palindromic_length(i, 1, new_input_string). RESULT length]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over all indices of new_input_string, if max_length is strictly less than length, update max_length to length and set start to i; if the values are equal or max_length is greater, keep the earlier stored values unchanged. RESULT max_length, start]
            [COMMAND Iterate over the slice new_input_string[start - max_length : start + max_length + 1], which includes positions from start - max_length through start + max_length, and within that loop append each character i to output_string only when i is not equal to "|". RESULT output_string]
            [COMMAND Return output_string. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
